settings.subtitle: Thanet Coastal Social & Cultural Directory
settings.tagline: Discover what's happening across Margate, Ramsgate & Broadstairs
settings.bannerText: MARGATE • RAMSGATE • BROADSTAIRS • LIVE COMMUNITY UPDATES

events.title: Ramsgate Town Shed: Adult Woodwork, DIY & Practical Skills Community Workshop
events.venue: Ramsgate Town Shed, 12 School Lane
events.description: Free, welcoming adult woodwork and DIY community workshop. Work on your own personal projects or shared town community builds, learn practical carpentry skills from peers, and naturally chat and connect while working with your hands. Monday & Wednesday daytime sessions.

events.title: Rusty Rackets: Adult Beginner & Returner Tennis (4 Weeks Free Tuition)
events.venue: Margate Lawn Tennis Club & Broadstairs LTC
events.description: Designed specifically for adult beginners and ex-players looking to dust off the cobwebs. Enjoy 4 weeks of completely free LTA-qualified tuition. A fantastic 'get fitter and see the same friendly faces weekly' community group across Margate and Broadstairs.

events.title: Thanet Indoor Bowls: Social Roll-Up & Welcoming Visitors Taster
events.venue: Thanet Indoor Bowls Centre, Fifth Avenue, Cliftonville
events.description: Not flashy, but a genuinely social, accessible sport with an open, friendly visitors' setup. Low fitness barrier, easy natural conversation, and great camaraderie on the carpet rinks. Free bowls hire and coaching on hand for first-timers.

events.title: TCDT Community Workshops: Cookery, Craft & Thanet History Clubs
events.venue: Hereson Family & Community Centre, Lillian Road, Ramsgate
events.description: Engaging weekly cookery, craft, and local coastal history clubs run by the Thanet Community Development Trust. Better for genuine human connection than one-off nightlife because you share an active, focused project to talk about together.

events.title: The Sunken Garden: Volunteer Coastal Gardening & Green Care Day
events.venue: The Sunken Garden, Royal Esplanade, Westbrook
events.description: Volunteer community gardening on the clifftops of Westbrook. Physical, purposeful, outdoor activity surrounded by sea air with a relaxed, welcoming crowd. Gloves, trowels, pruning gear, and tea & biscuits provided. Calm and grounding.

events.title: Board at Home: Structured Tabletop & Board Game Social Club
events.venue: Board at Home, 107A High Street, Ramsgate
events.description: Specifically designed for people to come solo as well as with friends! Over 300 modern board games, friendly game hosts who teach all the rules, and a relaxed, structured social setting with none of the awkward small talk.

events.title: Active Thanet: Inclusive Community Sports & Taster Sessions
events.venue: Thanet Parks & Community Centres (Margate, Ramsgate & Broadstairs)
events.description: A brilliant route into inclusive sports you would not normally think to search for! Active Thanet coordinates free taster sessions across the district, including street sports, multi-sports, walking football, and disability-accessible activities.

events.title: Simply Connect Thanet: Social Prescribing & Community Volunteering Hub
events.venue: Thanet Community Hub & Digital Directory, Isle of Thanet
events.description: The quickest way to find volunteering, gardening projects, craft circles, peer support groups, and community projects across Margate, Ramsgate, and Broadstairs. Accredited local social prescribing gateway connecting you to grassroots activities.

events.title: 80s & 90s Over 30s Daytime Clubbing - Margate (Beyond 30 Day Party)
events.venue: The Drill Shed, Margate Lido Complex
events.description: The UK's smash-hit over-30s daytime clubbing sensation lands in Margate! Party hard to non-stop 80s & 90s retro bangers and club classics at The Drill Shed inside the historic Margate Lido Complex. 4:00 PM to 9:00 PM means all the euphoria of a massive night out with NO late nights and NO hangxiety! Age 25+.

events.title: Heidi (Jackathon) Live: House Music That Never Forgets to Be Fun
events.venue: Faith In Strangers, 17 Ethelbert Crescent, Cliftonville
events.description: House music that never forgets to be fun. World-renowned DJ and Jackathon creator Heidi headlines the cliffside discotheque loft at Faith In Strangers. Experience high-octane house grooves powered by the custom-built Poseidon Sound System overlooking panoramic North Sea waves.

events.title: REWD Intro to Padel: Beginner Masterclass & Social Play
events.venue: REWD Padel & Wellness Lounge, Cargo Way
events.description: Designed for complete beginners, these sessions are the perfect way to learn padel basics, racket techniques, and build court confidence. Step onto our brand new panoramic indoor courts in a fun, relaxed, and welcoming environment. No membership required to enjoy the club! Bring your leaflet for a FREE coffee at the REWD Lounge.

events.title: REWD Intro to Pilates: Core Strength & Mobility Reset
events.venue: REWD Pilates Studio, Cargo Way
events.description: Build strength, improve mobility, and reset your body with REWD Pilates classes. Designed for all fitness levels with a specialized focus on core strength, spinal posture, flexibility, and post-workout recovery. Bookable via Nettla.

events.title: REWD Spin: High-Energy Coastal Ride & Full-Body Workout
events.venue: REWD Spin Suite, Cargo Way
events.description: High-energy spin classes designed to build endurance, boost cardio fitness, and leave you feeling energized for the week. Expect great music, motivating coaches, and a full-body workout for all levels. Complimentary recovery coffee at REWD Lounge with promotion leaflet.

events.title: Walpole Bay Sunrise Tidal Swim & Coffee Social
events.venue: Walpole Bay Tidal Pool, Cliftonville
events.description: Start your Sunday morning with a crisp, rejuvenating dip in the UK's largest tidal pool! We meet on the steps at 7:30 AM, swim at whatever pace you like, followed by hot flasks of coffee and pastries on the promenade. All swim abilities welcome — neoprene or skins!

events.title: Margate Creative Tech & Founder Meetup
events.venue: Marine Studios, 17 Albert Terrace
events.description: Calling all designers, software developers, remote workers, and startup founders in Thanet. Casual fireside chat with local founders followed by open networking, pizza, and local craft drinks. Come share what you're building!

events.title: The Judgement-Free Tattoo Learning & Practice Community
events.venue: Marine Studios & Creative Quarter, Margate
events.description: Welcome to a dedicated, judgement-free space for apprentice and learner tattooists across Thanet! Practice on fake skin, hone your linework in sketchbooks, share advice on hygiene, machine tuning, and technique without industry gatekeeping. Bring your gear, flash sheets, and current projects to connect with 31+ fellow local artists.

events.title: Thanet Coast Project: Botany Bay Marine Clean & Ecology Walk
events.venue: Botany Bay Chalk Stacks Meeting Point
events.description: Join fellow coastal caretakers for a 2-hour marine litter survey and beach clean beneath the famous white chalk cliffs of Botany Bay. Litter pickers, bags, and gloves provided. Includes a 20-minute guided talk on local chalk reef marine biodiversity.

events.title: Ramsgate Harbour Acoustic Sessions & Craft Ale Social
events.venue: Ramsgate Music Hall & Arch 6 Taproom
events.description: Intimate acoustic showcase featuring 3 breakthrough singer-songwriters from Kent and South London. Hosted in the historic harbour arches with local Gadds beers and organic ciders on tap. Ticket proceeds directly support independent artists.

events.title: Viking Coastal Trail Group Social Ride (30km Gentle)
events.venue: Starts at Ramsgate Maritime Museum
events.description: A leisurely, no-drop social bike ride hugging the coastline from Ramsgate through Broadstairs to Margate and back. Paved cycle paths with breathtaking sea views. Helmets required; hybrid, road, or e-bikes all welcome. Coffee & cake stop halfway at Margate Harbour Arm.

events.title: Windmill Community Gardens Saturday Harvest & Soil Care
events.venue: Windmill Community Gardens, Dane Valley
events.description: Get your hands in the soil! Volunteer with our community permaculture garden. We are prepping winter beds, harvesting late squash and herbs, and building compost heaps. Tea and homemade herbal infusions provided. No gardening experience necessary.

events.title: Broadstairs Sunset Beach Volleyball & Spikeball Social
events.venue: Viking Bay Beach (near the Pavilion)
events.description: Friendly drop-in 4v4 volleyball and Spikeball nets on the sand at Viking Bay. Friendly, casual vibes with an upbeat playlist. We rotate teams so you can arrive solo and immediately join a squad.

events.title: Turner Contemporary Late: Experimental Drawing & Ambient Vinyl
events.venue: Turner Contemporary, Rendezvous
events.description: After-hours gallery access with a drop-in charcoal & mixed media drawing workshop guided by local artists, accompanied by ambient vinyl sets looking out over the sunset sea. Bar open with organic natural wines and non-alcoholic infusions.

events.title: Margate Board Game Guild & Craft Beer Night
events.venue: Elsewhere, The Centre, Margate
events.description: Over 80 modern board games available to play — from Catan and Wingspan to casual party deduction games like Secret Hitler and Codenames. Arrive alone or with friends; our hosts teach games and introduce everyone to a table.

events.title: Broadstairs Dickens & Heritage Walking Book Club
events.venue: Bleak House Steps / Victoria Gardens
events.description: A stroll and literary chat along the clifftops where Charles Dickens spent his summers. This month we discuss contemporary seaside fiction and local history while taking in the fresh sea breeze.

events.title: Ramsgate Royal Harbour Youth Mentoring & Workshop
events.venue: Pie Factory Music, St Luke's Avenue
events.description: Volunteer mentors needed to support local youth with creative music recording, photography, and resume coaching in a welcoming, community-owned studio setting. Full training and safeguarding checks arranged.

events.title: Margate Old Town Vintage Flea & Independent Record Fair
events.venue: Market Place, Margate Old Town
events.description: Discover rare vinyl, mid-century homewares, upcycled fashion, and artisan food stalls tucked in the historic cobbles of Margate Old Town. Street buskers and specialty coffee roasters on site all day.

events.title: The Wonder Stuff + Inspiral Carpets (Live)
events.venue: Hall By The Sea, Dreamland Margate
events.description: Legendary indie rock icons The Wonder Stuff co-headline with Madchester pioneers Inspiral Carpets for a huge night of anthems at Hall By The Sea, Dreamland Margate.

events.title: Fell Out Boy & The Black Charade (Emo Anthems)
events.venue: Hall By The Sea, Dreamland Margate
events.description: The UK's premier emo and pop-punk tribute experience bringing the explosive anthems of Fall Out Boy and My Chemical Romance to Hall By The Sea!

events.title: Breakin Science & Drumatics – Halloween Drum & Bass Warm Up
events.venue: Hall By The Sea, Dreamland Margate
events.description: Breakin Science & Drumatics team up for the ultimate Halloween Drum & Bass, Jungle & Bassline party across Dreamland with heavy basslines and top-tier MCs.

events.title: Definitely Oasis (Ultimate Oasis Tribute Live)
events.venue: Hall By The Sea, Dreamland Margate
events.description: The world's leading Oasis tribute band, recreating the electric swagger and stadium anthems of Liam and Noel Gallagher on stage at Dreamland Margate.

events.title: Soil + Adema (Nu-Metal & Alt Rock Live)
events.venue: Hall By The Sea, Dreamland Margate
events.description: Heavy alternative rock & nu-metal co-headline tour hitting Margate featuring Soil performing their iconic tracks alongside Adema.

events.title: The Rifles (20th Anniversary Tour)
events.venue: Hall By The Sea, Dreamland Margate
events.description: Indie rock favourites The Rifles celebrate two decades with their full electric headline tour live at Hall By The Sea.

events.title: RNB MANIA (90s & 00s RnB Festival Club Night)
events.venue: Hall By The Sea, Dreamland Margate
events.description: The UK's biggest celebration of 90s & 00s RnB, Slow Jams and classic Hip-Hop takes over Dreamland with celebrity guest DJs and high-energy dancers.

events.title: Martin Kemp: Back To The 80s Xmas Special
events.venue: Hall By The Sea, Dreamland Margate
events.description: Spandau Ballet star Martin Kemp returns to Dreamland Margate for his sensational, sold-out Back To The 80s Christmas party DJ set!

events.title: BBC Radio 2 Dance: Sounds of the 90s with Vernon Kay
events.venue: Hall By The Sea, Dreamland Margate
events.description: Vernon Kay brings BBC Radio 2 Dance's Sounds of the 90s tour to Dreamland! Dance anthems, club bangers, and live stage visuals.

events.title: Hartsdown Park 5-a-Side Football: Wednesday Floodlit Social League
events.venue: Hartsdown Park 3G Pitches, Hartsdown Road, Margate
events.description: Friendly, competitive 5-a-side football on the pristine 3G all-weather floodlit pitches at Hartsdown Park. Teams or individual solo players welcome — we match free agents into balanced squads. Bibs, match balls, and FA-qualified referees provided. Post-match drinks at the clubhouse.

events.title: Hartsdown Park Sunday Morning Friendly 5-a-Side & Walking Football
events.venue: Hartsdown Leisure Centre Pitches, Margate
events.description: Low-impact, highly social friendly football for all fitness levels. We run side-by-side pitches for active 5-a-side and walking football. Great for injury recovery, staying sharp, and meeting fellow football enthusiasts in Margate.

events.title: Margate Hartsdown & Tivoli 5K Community Run & Post-Run Coffee
events.venue: Hartsdown Park Main Gates, Margate
events.description: Free, fun, and friendly weekly 5k community run and fitness walk through the scenic paths of Hartsdown Park and Tivoli Woods. Walk, jog, or sprint at your own tempo with tail-walkers ensuring nobody is left behind. Coffee and pastries together at Hartsdown Cafe afterwards!

events.title: Ramsgate Coastal Boxing Conditioning & Sunrise HIIT
events.venue: East Cliff Prom & Marina Esplanade, Ramsgate
events.description: High-energy outdoor boxing pad-work, agility drills, and bodyweight conditioning overlooking Ramsgate Royal Harbour. Gloves and pads provided. Beginners welcome.

events.title: Cliftonville Bandstand Seafront Pilates & Vinyasa Flow
events.venue: Cliftonville Bandstand Lawns, Eastern Esplanade
events.description: Strengthen your core and breathe in the salty sea air. Dynamic mat Pilates followed by grounding yoga flow on the cliff lawns looking out over Margate sands. Bring a yoga mat or beach towel.

events.title: Broadstairs Clifftop Photography & Golden Hour Walk
events.venue: Louisa Bay to Joss Bay Path
events.description: Capture the golden hour light striking the famous chalk headlands. Bring any camera or smartphone. Our group leader gives landscape composition tips.

events.title: Thanet Language & Culture Exchange
events.venue: Ravensgate Arms, King Street
events.description: Practice French, Spanish, Italian, Japanese, or English with native speakers in a friendly pub atmosphere. Beginners to fluent speakers welcome!

events.title: Margate Digital Nomads & Remote Workers Friday Co-work
events.venue: The Bus Cafe & Harbour Arm
events.description: Join remote workers, software engineers, and freelancers for a productive co-working session overlooking the Margate sands, followed by sundowners.

venues.name: Dreamland Margate
venues.description: Iconic seaside amusement park and world-class live music venue featuring the Scenic Stage and Hall By The Sea.

venues.name: The Drill Shed (Margate Lido Complex)
venues.description: Historic seaside cavern and subterranean events hall nestled into the Margate Lido coastal complex in Cliftonville.

venues.name: Faith In Strangers
venues.description: Seafront discotheque loft, cultural space, and music venue overlooking the Cliftonville coastline with custom Poseidon Sound System.

venues.name: REWD Padel & Wellness Lounge
venues.address: Unit 1 Cargo Way, Westwood / Ramsgate-Margate CT12 5NP
venues.description: Thanet's premier purpose-built indoor padel club, reformer Pilates studio, high-energy spin room, and relaxing social café lounge.

venues.name: Walpole Bay Tidal Pool
venues.description: The UK's largest tidal swimming pool, Grade II listed saltwater haven for year-round swimmers and sunrise coffee.

venues.name: Turner Contemporary
venues.description: Celebrated modern art gallery on Margate seafront hosting international exhibitions, late nights, and workshops.

venues.name: Ramsgate Music Hall
venues.description: NME award-winning 140-capacity intimate live music sanctuary with pristine acoustics and craft beer.

venues.name: Marine Studios
venues.description: Creative hub, co-working space, and community gallery overlooking the Margate harbor.

venues.name: Botany Bay & Chalk Stacks
venues.description: Spectacular white chalk cliffs, rock pools, and marine conservation zone.

venues.name: Hartsdown Park & Leisure Centre
venues.description: 3G all-weather floodlit pitches, grass sports grounds, and community recreation pavilion.

venues.name: Ramsgate Town Shed
venues.description: Volunteer-led adult woodwork and DIY community workshop for practical carpentry and friendly connection.

venues.name: The Sunken Garden
venues.description: Sheltered seafront cliff garden offering peaceful volunteer gardening and green care.

venues.name: Board at Home Gaming Hub
venues.description: Ramsgate tabletop gaming lounge with 300+ board games, designed for solo and group visitors.

venues.name: Thanet Indoor Bowls Centre
venues.description: Championship indoor carpet bowls rink offering friendly social roll-ups and low barrier exercise.

venues.name: Hereson Community Centre (TCDT)
venues.description: Thanet Community Development Trust grassroots hub for cookery, crafts, and heritage learning.
